note: 14-inch M5 Max thermal comparison on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-4bit. 'sustained' = the model's turn deep in the overnight back-to-back ladder (hot chassis). 'cold' = a single isolated run on an idle, cool machine. Same model, same harness, same prompts.
machine: Apple M5 Max (40-core GPU, 614 GB/s) — 14-inch MacBook Pro, 128GB
finding: Decode (memory-bandwidth-bound) is barely affected by throttling; prefill (compute-bound) drops ~2.5x when hot, which is what inflates TTFT. The 14-inch thermal tax lands on prompt-processing, not generation.

summary.chassis_note: 14-inch caps ~45W; independent testing shows up to ~25% sustained GPU drop vs the 16-inch which holds steady.
